form.name: Option Name
form.requiredCaution: Marking this option as required means every variant of this product must supply a value for it. If this option has no values yet, variants can't be saved until you add some.
form.nameInfo: Shown to customers picking this option (e.g., "Color", "Size").
form.codeInfo: Machine-friendly slug used in APIs and URLs. Lowercase, no spaces.
form.dataTypeInfo: Text/Number/Color lists use predefined values. Free Text and Free Number accept arbitrary input.
form.minValueInfo: Smallest numeric value accepted. Only applies to numeric data types.
form.maxValueInfo: Largest numeric value accepted. Only applies to numeric data types.
form.sortOrderInfo: Lower numbers appear first when options are listed.
form.activeInfo: Inactive options are hidden from new variants but preserved on existing rows.
form.descriptionInfo: Optional internal description. Up to 500 characters.

empty.title: No Options
empty.message: No product options have been added yet.
empty.valueMessage: No values have been added to this option yet.

confirm.deleteOption: Are you sure you want to delete this option? All associated values will also be removed.
confirm.deleteValue: Are you sure you want to delete this value?
